run_evaluate_linear_probe: run the evaluate function to featurize datasets, train a linear probe, and report accuracy metrics
train_linear_classifier: train a linear classification head on extracted features using AdamW optimizer with cosine learning rate scheduling
infer_model_predictions: run inference with a trained linear probe model over a dataloader and return logits and targets
create_featurizer_wrapper: create a Featurizer module that wraps a model to extract and normalize image features via encode_image
build_cosine_lr_scheduler: build a cosine annealing learning rate scheduler with optional warmup for an optimizer
